meta.name: feature-spec
meta.description: Creates a complete product feature specification with acceptance criteria, scope, dependencies, and risks. Delegates to the Prometeo (PM) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成完整的产品功能规格说明书
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将产品想法转化为结构化的功能规格和验收标准。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a complete product feature specification
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn product ideas into structured specs with acceptance criteria.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成一个产品功能规格的编写流程，包括检查身份、任务和记忆，调研已有规格，生成一份包含验收条件、范围、依赖和风险的完整文档，最后准备交接给开发代理。
howto.when: 当你需要定义一个新功能、编写用户故事或记录业务需求时，可以触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个用户登录功能的规格文档。
为多租户计费系统创建功能规格。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含 Stripe 集成的规格。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through a product feature specification workflow: check identity/task/memory, research existing specs, generate a comprehensive spec document with acceptance criteria, scope, dependencies, and risks, then prepare a handoff to the Dev agent.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you need to define a new feature, write user stories, or document business requirements.

say_en.text: Write a spec for user login with JWT.
Create a spec for multi-tenant billing with Stripe.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full spec.
